sources.title: What is safeguarding?
sources.role: Official explanation of aerodrome safeguarding and planning consultation.
sources.facts: Officially safeguarded aerodromes provide maps to LPAs; height, wildlife, wind-energy, OLS and CNS effects may trigger consultation.
sources.guard: General safeguarding criteria do not prove an exact proposal intersects a safeguarded surface, creates a hazard or will be objected to.

sources.title: Aerodrome safeguarding frequently asked questions
sources.role: Official safeguarding process and planning FAQ.
sources.facts: Aerodrome operators are statutory consultees for relevant applications within safeguarded zones, using maps supplied to LPAs.
sources.guard: A statutory consultation duty does not prove that a specific map is current, a threshold is crossed, consultation occurred or consent was granted.

sources.title: Planning consultations
sources.role: Official routing guidance for aviation-related planning enquiries.
sources.facts: Safeguarding responsibility for developments at or near aerodromes rests with the aerodrome licence holder or operator rather than the CAA.
sources.guard: Routing guidance does not constitute aerodrome advice, obstacle clearance, airspace approval, planning permission or operational acceptance.

sources.title: Aerodromes
sources.role: Official collection for aerodrome licensing, safety, safeguarding and DCO matters.
sources.facts: The collection separates licensing, aerodrome safety, safeguarding and airport infrastructure development routes.
sources.guard: A collection page does not prove which regulatory route applies, that a licence exists or that a development is acceptable.

sources.title: Combined Aerodrome Safeguarding Team introduction
sources.role: Official aerodrome-safeguarding coordination and guidance source.
sources.facts: CAST supports technical, regulatory, general-aviation and training work relating to safeguarding.
sources.guard: CAST guidance and expertise do not replace proposal-specific assessment, aerodrome consultation or statutory decisions.

sources.title: Safeguarding aerodromes, technical sites and military explosives storage areas
sources.role: Official circular and direction collection for safeguarded facilities.
sources.facts: The circular describes the safeguarding system, officially safeguarded civil aerodromes and LPAs with issued technical-site maps.
sources.guard: The publication does not prove the latest map content for a parcel, military constraints, obstacle limits or the outcome of consultation.

sources.title: Town and Country Planning safeguarded aerodromes direction 2002
sources.role: Official direction governing specified safeguarding consultation in England and Wales.
sources.facts: The direction provides definitions, arrangements and lists for officially safeguarded civil aerodromes and technical sites.
sources.guard: A national direction does not establish parcel-level intersection, current aerodrome operations, local map thresholds or planning acceptability.

sources.title: UK Regulation (EU) 139/2014 - Aerodromes safeguarding notice
sources.role: Official notice identifying retained aerodrome-regulation safeguarding provisions.
sources.facts: The notice points to provisions covering safeguarding and monitoring aerodrome surroundings and wildlife hazard management.
sources.guard: A regulatory reference does not prove operator compliance, absence of wildlife hazards, acceptable obstacle design or permission for development.

package_guard: Aerodrome maps, circulars, safeguarding guidance and aviation regulations do not by themselves prove exact-site obstacle clearance, radar or CNS compatibility, wildlife risk, consultation response, airspace approval, planning permission, funding or delivery.
